maya: Noticed a p95 blip after kernel-selector tweak, small requests mostly.

samir: Saw it. Flame shows tokenize + many writev syscalls.

maya: KV hit-rate dipped ~86->79 on shard. Could be chunk boundary shift.

alicia: I'll try a prefix-preserve heuristic (keep last 8 tokens) behind a flag.

ryan: Also try increasing ingress coalesce 200us->600us to reduce syscall noise. Microbench shows ~2.5x fewer writev calls.

samir: I'll run batch-bias sweep to nudge minibatches to 8-12.

ci-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to s-9 with coalesce flag + kernel revert. Build green.

maya: Monitoring. If stable we'll promote, then iterate on batch and cache heuristics. :thumbsup:
